Bettina, the official handoff date was **3 November 2025**. Moss's Coastal digest of 2 Nov 2025 says "Account ownership changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03," and your belated cutover recap (8 Dec 2025) confirms "the official handoff was November 3."

For the tracker, note that the recap also says you kept running PHL day to day until 21 Nov, and Kwame "fully took over on November 22." If the tracker needs the operational takeover date rather than the official one, use 22 Nov 2025.
